name: 14" Ultrabook Laptop
description: A slim, powerful 14-inch laptop built for developers on the move — long battery life, a bright display, and enough power for local containers and multiple browser tabs without breaking a sweat.

name: 14" Portable USB-C Monitor
description: A lightweight second screen that powers over a single USB-C cable — slips into a laptop bag and turns any desk into a dual-monitor setup in seconds.

name: Compact Wireless Keyboard
description: A low-profile wireless keyboard designed for long typing sessions — quiet keys, multi-device pairing, and a footprint small enough to leave room for a mouse right next to it.

name: Precision Wireless Mouse
description: An ergonomic wireless mouse with a precise sensor and customizable buttons — built for developers who spend all day navigating code, dashboards, and terminals.

name: Adjustable Laptop Stand
description: A foldable aluminum stand that raises your laptop to eye level and improves airflow underneath — collapses flat for travel.

name: LED Monitor Light Bar
description: A glare-free light bar that clips to the top of your monitor and lights your desk without washing out the screen — adjustable brightness and color temperature.

name: Noise-Cancelling Headphones
description: Over-ear wireless headphones with active noise cancellation — built for deep-focus work sessions and calls in noisy environments alike.

name: Portable External SSD 1TB
description: A pocket-sized 1TB SSD with fast USB-C transfer speeds — reliable local backups for projects, VMs, and anything you don't want to lose.
